description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple's customers every single day.

Description
We are looking for an embedded engineer at heart who is just as comfortable in the higher layers of the stack. You are happiest when you are bringing up a new board, reading a datasheet, and chasing a bug with a scope and a debugger. You also know that a working system needs more than firmware: host-side software, tooling, automation, and data flow. You will write low-level code in C and the surrounding software in Python and C++, and you will connect the two. You are not a specialist in one layer. You are the person who learns whatever the problem requires, integrates the hardware and software that need to work together, and delivers a working solution end to end.

Responsibilities
Develop embedded software and firmware in C for custom hardware, including drivers, peripheral interfaces, and communication protocols.
Bring up new hardware platforms and debug across the hardware/software boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
Build the host-side software that talks to embedded targets: tools, libraries, test automation, and data-collection software in Python and C++.
Integrate diverse systems, devices, sensors, and tools, including ones that were never designed to work together.
Build and maintain automated hardware-in-the-loop test and CI infrastructure.
Make advanced AI coding tools a core part of how you build and help set the standard for how a small team moves fast with them.
Participate in design and code reviews, and write clear, maintainable, well-documented code.

Minimum qualifications
BS or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency in C with strong embedded software experience, including work close to the hardware (microcontrollers, drivers, or board bring-up).
Working knowledge of Python and C++ for tooling, test automation, and host-side software.
Experience with common hardware interfaces and protocols (e.g., SPI, I2C, UART, USB).

Preferred qualifications
3+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code, including embedded or firmware-adjacent systems.
Experience with RTOS or bare-metal development on ARM Cortex-M/A platforms (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), and with low-latency or timing-critical code.
Experience with embedded Linux, kernel drivers, or cross-compilation toolchains and build systems.
Experience with sensors, signal acquisition, or DSP, and with wireless protocols such as BLE.
Experience developing host-side applications on macOS or iOS (Swift or Objective-C).
Experience building hardware-in-the-loop test systems, CI/CD, and automated validation.
Background in startups, research environments, or small teams.
Fluent with git and modern development workflows (testing, code review).
